What a customer types. The site is reached here whatever press calls it.

fields.description: Only ever a hash. The token itself is written into that site's own config once and never read back.
fields.label: Token Hash
Storage
fields.description: Measured by listing the prefix, not reported by the workspace. A workspace that reports its own usage is a workspace that can under-report it.

fields.label: Promised
fields.description: Signed for since that measurement. A signed URL is a promise somebody may keep, so it counts until the next measurement says whether it was.

fields.label: Limit
fields.description: Bytes, so it is a Long Int: twenty-five gigabytes does not fit in an Int. Zero means unmetered — a plan with no storage line is a plan nobody thought about, and refusing every upload is the worse answer.
